package.name: @frontier-infra/audit
package.provenance: The bundled lane provides integrity from an operator-approved plugin distribution; bootstrap does not independently establish publisher authenticity. The registry lane remains blocked until npm integrity and publisher provenance are pinned.

bundle.root: The installed Frontier Audit plugin distribution explicitly approved by the operator.
chain: sdk-lock bundled artifact SHA-256 binds the SDK tarball
bootstrap package-tree SHA-256 binds the installed SDK files
SDK audit-snapshot-lock SHA-256 binds scorer and AAR source snapshots

tarball.root: The absolute local tarball path and SHA-256 explicitly approved by the operator.
chain: operator supplies the expected tarball SHA-256
bootstrap verifies the tarball SHA-256 before installation
bootstrap package-tree SHA-256 binds the installed SDK files
SDK audit-snapshot-lock SHA-256 binds scorer and AAR source snapshots
